body:
This BTC-only implementation adds three registered alpha mechanisms for spotquant, causal public features and a source-bound manual paper ledger. Candidate rules, original fees/execution/protection accounting and adoption gates are fixed before financial outcomes.

Implementation and scoped independent reviews are complete, including native cold-start checkpoint and source reconstruction fixes. The default trading runtime remains the accepted incumbent. The complete registered financial matrix (52 unscaled, 8 actual-risk, 2 timing diagnostics, 6 baseline budget accounts plus rule-required combinations/selected budgets) has not started; adoption, full financial review and real paper initialization remain pending.

Validation: final affected checks and six retained exact-commit synthetic CLI audits pass. Exact current-head GitHub CI is requested by this save. Synthetic observations are not performance evidence. Native cases 0, actual account-days 0, NOT_QUALIFIED.

PROJECT_STATE.md is the current progress record; original measurements, failed probes and review evidence are preserved. Research and historical improvement do not establish prospective alpha or original return-target achievement.
